{{Otheruses|Lake}}
'''Savvam Lake''' was an artificial [[lake]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Lined with genetically-engineered [[Plant/Legends|plants]] and [[Tree/Legends|trees]] that bloomed [[Standard year/Legends|year]] round, it was a place of relaxation for the rich.<ref name="AS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>

The lake was located two hundred stories high, sitting atop the roof of many interlocking buildings.<ref name="AS" />
